headerDisplay: Exposes your PinPaw GPS pet trackers to HomeKit as battery, at-home and motion sensors.
footerDisplay: Create an API token in the PinPaw app under **Settings > API tokens** (requires app 1.6.0 or newer).

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: Personal access token from the PinPaw app. Starts with ppw_pat_.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to ask PinPaw for fresh data. Values below 15 are raised to 15.

home.title: Home location
home.description: Needed for the At Home sensor. Leave empty to skip it.

radius.title: Radius (metres)
radius.description: How far from the coordinates still counts as home.

exposeMotion.title: Expose the motion sensor
exposeMotion.description: Uncheck if you do not want a motion sensor per pet in the Home app.

baseUrl.title: API base URL
baseUrl.description: Only change this if you were told to.
